local rootModel = script.Parent
local ArrowPrefab = rootModel:WaitForChild("炮台"):WaitForChild("箭")
local ArrowFire = rootModel:WaitForChild("RootPart"):WaitForChild("Arrow Fire")

local v_target = rootModel:WaitForChild("target")
local v_arrowSpeed = rootModel:WaitForChild("arrowSpeed")
local FireS2C = rootModel:WaitForChild("FireS2C")

local paotai = rootModel:WaitForChild("炮台")

FireS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(target:Model) 
	if not target then return end
	local Arrow = ArrowPrefab:Clone()
	Arrow.Parent = workspace
	local Torso:Part = target:FindFirstChild("Torso") or target:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	
	ArrowFire:Play()
	local targetPos:Vector3
	if Torso then
		targetPos = Torso:GetPivot().Position
	else
		targetPos = target:GetPivot().Position
	end
	local paotaiPos = paotai:GetPivot().Position

	paotai:PivotTo(CFrame.new(paotaiPos,Vector3.new(targetPos.X,paotaiPos.Y,targetPos.Z)))

	local distance = (targetPos - paotaiPos).Magnitude
	local totalTime = distance / v_arrowSpeed.Value
	local t = 0
	game.Debris:AddItem(Arrow,10)
	while Arrow:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		local dt = RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(target) then
			Arrow:Destroy()
			break
		end
		t += dt
		local rate = math.clamp(t / totalTime,0,1)
		
		local targetPos:Vector3 = target:GetPivot().Position
		local offset = targetPos - Arrow.Position
		local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos,targetPos + offset.Unit)
		local curCFrame = Arrow.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame,rate)
		Arrow.CFrame = curCFrame.Rotation + (Arrow.Position + curCFrame.LookVector * v_arrowSpeed.Value * dt)
		
		if rate >= 1 then
			Arrow:Destroy()
		end
	end
end)"},{"id":105,"text":"if script:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Prefabs) then return end

local _rootModel = script.Parent

local v_dayCD:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(_gameController,TimeValue.cd)
local v_gold:IntValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(_bench,CraftingBenchValue.gold)
local v_activate = _rootModel.activate

local _stratTweens:{Tween} = {}
local _stopTweens:{Tween} = {}

local _needGold = 2

function init()
	local startTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(5)
	local stopTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(5)
	for _,part:BasePart in ipairs(_rootModel:WaitForChild("circles"):GetChildren()) do
		local av:AngularVelocity = part:WaitForChild("AngularVelocity")
		if av then		
			--part.CFrame = _rootModel.RootPart.CFrame.Rotation + part.Position -- 复位旋转
			local startTween = game.TweenService:Create(av,startTweenInfo,{
				AngularVelocity = av.AngularVelocity * 2
			})
			table.insert(_stratTweens,startTween)

			local stopTween = game.TweenService:Create(av,stopTweenInfo,{
				AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			})
			table.insert(_stopTweens,stopTween)
			av.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end		
end

function onActivateChanged()
	local activate = v_activate.Value
	
	-- 播放动画
	local tweens = v_activate.Value and _stratTweens or _stopTweens
	for _,tween:Tween in ipairs(tweens) do
		tween:Play()
	end

	for _,par in ipairs(_rootModel.Center:GetDescendants()) do
		if par:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			par.Enabled = v_activate.Value
		end
	end
	
	-- 设置UI显示
	_rootModel.Main.BillboardGui.Enabled = not activate

	-- 设置交互按钮开关
	_rootModel.Main.ProximityPrompt.Enabled = not activate

	if activate then
		_rootModel.Main.ActivateSound:Play()
	end
end

function onGoldChanged()
	local t_gold = _rootModel.Main.BillboardGui.t_gold
	t_gold.Text = string.format("%d/%d",v_gold.Value,_needGold)
	t_gold.TextColor3 = v_gold.Value >= _needGold and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.new(1,0,0)
end	

init()
onActivateChanged()
onGoldChanged()
v_gold.Changed:Connect(onGoldChanged)
v_activate.Changed:Connect(onActivateChanged)
_rootModel.Main.ProximityPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(playerWhoTriggered: Player) 
	if v_activate.Value then return end

	if v_gold.Value >= _needGold then
		v_activate.Value = true
		v_gold.Value -= _needGold
	else
		local text = string.format("Need more gold! (%d/%d)",v_gold.Value,_needGold)
		UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(playerWhoTriggered,text,UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
	end
end)
v_isDaytime.Changed:Connect(function() 
	if not v_isDaytime.Value then
		-- 天黑了
		if v_activate.Value then
			task.wait(1)
			v_dayCD.Value = 1
			task.wait(1)
			-- 发动时间机器
			v_activate.Value = false
		end
	end
end)"},{"id":106,"text":"if script:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Prefabs) then return end

local v_activate = _rootModel.activate
local v_triggerTimes = _rootModel.triggerTimes

function onActivateChanged()
	
	local activate = v_activate.Value
	-- 设置十字架颜色
	local material = activate and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.Plastic
	local color = activate and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 127)
	for _,basePart:BasePart in ipairs(_rootModel:FindFirstChild("十字架"):GetDescendants()) do
		if basePart:IsA("BasePart") then
			basePart.Material = material
			basePart.Color = color
		end
	end
	
	-- 设置UI显示
	_rootModel.Main.BillboardGui.Enabled = not activate
	
	-- 设置交互按钮开关
	_rootModel.Main.ProximityPrompt.Enabled = not activate
	
	if activate then
		_rootModel.Main.ActivateSound:Play()
	end
end

function onGoldChanged()
	local needGold = getNeedGold()
	local t_gold = _rootModel.Main.BillboardGui.t_gold
	t_gold.Text = string.format("%d/%d",v_gold.Value,needGold)
	t_gold.TextColor3 = v_gold.Value >= needGold and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.new(1,0,0)
end

function getNeedGold()	
	local num = 2
	for i=1,v_triggerTimes.Value do
		num *= 2
	end
	return num
end

onActivateChanged()
onGoldChanged()
v_gold.Changed:Connect(onGoldChanged)
v_activate.Changed:Connect(onActivateChanged)
v_triggerTimes.Changed:Connect(onGoldChanged)

local prompt = script.Parent.FishTrap
local meat = workspace.Meat
prompt.Enabled = false
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5)

local core = script.Parent
local Times = script.Parent.BillboardGui.Times

local flag = false

local count = 5

local waterSound = script.Parent:WaitForChild('water')

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
	if prompt.ActionText == "Take" then
		prompt.Enabled = false
		waterSound:Stop()
		flag = false
		prompt.ActionText = 'Not Ready'
		--count = count -1
		--Times.Text = count..'/5'
		core.MainSplash.Enabled = false
		core.Mist.Enabled = false
		--肉飞出来
		
		for i = 1, 4 do
			
			local temp =ResourcesItemHelper:CreateRawMeat(core.MeatBirth.WorldPosition)
			local item = CommonFunc:GetModel(temp)
			item.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
		end
		wait(5)
		prompt.Enabled = true
		--[[
		if count == 0 then
			script.Disabled = true
		end
		]]--
	else
		print('not ready yet')
	end
end)

while wait(1) do
	if flag == false then
		wait(math.random(180,210))

		waterSound:Play()
		core.MainSplash.Enabled = true
		core.Mist.Enabled = true
		prompt.Enabled = true
		prompt.ActionText = 'Take'
	end
end

local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local MapHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("MapHelper"))
local EffectHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EffectHelper"))
local UIHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))

local CraftingBenchValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CraftingBenchValue

local rootModel = script.Parent
local RootPart = rootModel.RootPart
local t_lv = rootModel.RootPart.BillboardGui.t_lv
local ProximityPrompt = RootPart.ProximityPrompt

local v_level = rootModel.level
local ironNeeds = rootModel:FindFirstChild("升级铁需求")

function onLevelChanged()

	local v_ironNeed:IntValue = ironNeeds:FindFirstChild(tostring(v_level.Value + 1))
	ProximityPrompt.Enabled = v_ironNeed ~= nil
	if v_ironNeed then
		t_lv.Text = string.format("lv.%d",v_level.Value)
		ProximityPrompt.ObjectText = string.format("🔩x%d",v_ironNeed.Value)
	else
		t_lv.Text = string.format("lv.%d Max",v_level.Value)
	end
end

onLevelChanged()
v_level.Changed:Connect(onLevelChanged)

ProximityPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(playerWhoTriggered: Player) 
	local v_ironNeed:IntValue = ironNeeds:FindFirstChild(tostring(v_level.Value + 1))
	if not v_ironNeed then return end

	local craftingBench:Model = MapHelper:GetCraftingBench()
	local v_iron:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(craftingBench, CraftingBenchValue.iron)
	if v_iron.Value >= v_ironNeed.Value then
		v_level.Value += 1
		v_iron.Value -= v_ironNeed.Value

		local upLvEff:Attachment = workspace.Prefabs.Effects.LeveUp:Clone()
		upLvEff.CFrame = CFrame.new()
		upLvEff.Parent = rootModel
		EffectHelper:AddItem(upLvEff,2)

		RootPart.upgrade:Play()
	else
		UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(playerWhoTriggered,"More iron is needed.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
	end
end)"},{"id":112,"text":"if script:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Prefabs) then return end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local EffectHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EffectHelper"))

local rootModel = script.Parent
local RootPart = rootModel:WaitForChild("RootPart")
local Peak = rootModel:WaitForChild("Peak")
local PointLight = Peak:WaitForChild("PointLight")
local beamPrefab = Peak:WaitForChild("Beam")
local lightning = RootPart:WaitForChild("lightning")

local v_atkCD = rootModel:WaitForChild("atkCD")
local v_target = rootModel:WaitForChild("target")
local FireS2C = rootModel:WaitForChild("FireS2C")

local originPointLightRange = 8
PointLight.Range = 0

function spawnBeam(start:BasePart,target:BasePart)
	if not target then return end
	
	local beam = beamPrefab:Clone()
	beam.Name = "闪电攻击"
	beam.Enabled = true
	beam.Parent = start or Peak
	beam.Attachment1:Destroy()
	--beam.Attachment1.WorldCFrame = target:GetPivot()	
	
	local Attachment1:Attachment = target:FindFirstChild("闪电塔Attachment1")
	if not Attachment1 then
		Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		Attachment1.Name = "闪电塔Attachment1"
		Attachment1.Parent = target
	end
	beam.Attachment1 = Attachment1

	lightning:Play()

	local lifeTime = v_atkCD.Value * 0.5
	game.Debris:AddItem(beam,lifeTime+0.1)
	
	if start == nil then
		-- 颜色变化
		Peak.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
		game.TweenService:Create(Peak,TweenInfo.new(v_atkCD.Value),{
			Color = Color3.new(1,1,1)
		}):Play()
		
		-- 光Tween
		PointLight.Range = originPointLightRange
		game.TweenService:Create(PointLight,TweenInfo.new(v_atkCD.Value),{
			Range = 0
		}):Play()
	end
	
	local t = 0
	while beam:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		local dt = task.wait()
		t += dt
		local rate = math.clamp(t / lifeTime,0,1)
		beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(rate)
		if t >= lifeTime then break end
	end
end

FireS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(start:BasePart,target:BasePart) 
	if not target then return end

	local beam = beamPrefab:Clone()
	beam.Name = "闪电攻击"
	beam.Enabled = true
	beam.Parent = start or Peak
	beam.Attachment1:Destroy()
	--beam.Attachment1.WorldCFrame = target:GetPivot()	

	local Attachment1:Attachment = target:FindFirstChild("闪电塔Attachment1")
	if not Attachment1 then
		Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		Attachment1.Name = "闪电塔Attachment1"
		Attachment1.Parent = target
	end
	beam.Attachment1 = Attachment1

	lightning:Play()

	local lifeTime = v_atkCD.Value * 0.5
	game.Debris:AddItem(beam,lifeTime+0.1)

	if start == nil then
		-- 颜色变化

		--每两天长出来
		if growGarden() then
			oldDay = v_day.Value
		end
	end

function hasProbability(p)
	local sum = 0
	-- 累加随机小数直到超过1，统计累加次数
	while sum < 1 do
		sum = sum + math.random()

		if sum < p then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local vegetableRarities={
	{id = 216, weight = 100},
	{id = 231, weight = 15},
	{id = 232, weight = 10},
}

function selectRandomVegetable()
	
	local veg = CommonFunc:WeightedRandomV1(vegetableRarities)
	return veg.id
	
end

function onItemSpawn(item:Model,att:Attachment)
	if not item then return end
	att:SetAttribute("busy",true)
	local v_lastDragPlayer:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(item,DragItemValue.lastDragPlayer)
	v_lastDragPlayer.Changed:Once(function(value: Instance) 
		--print("闲置")
		att:SetAttribute("busy",false)
	end)
	item.Destroying:Connect(function() 
		--print("闲置")
		att:SetAttribute("busy",false)
	end)
	if item.PrimaryPart then
		item.PrimaryPart:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Once(function() 
			att:SetAttribute("busy",false)
			--print("CFrame 闲置")
		end)
	end
end


function growGarden()
	local foodBirthArr = script.Parent.SetPlace:GetChildren()

	local isSpawn = false
	for	k,v in ipairs(foodBirthArr) do	
		if v:GetAttribute("busy") then continue end
		local id = 216
		if hasProbability(0.2) then
			id = selectRandomVegetable()
		end
		
		local offset = Vector3.zero
		if id == 216 then
			offset = Vector3.new(0,-1,0)
		end
		local temp = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(id)
		GameHelper:PlayDuang(temp)
		--temp.Parent = script.Parent.Food
		temp:PivotTo(v.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,temp.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/2,0)+offset)
		temp.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
		onItemSpawn(temp,v)
		isSpawn = true
	end
	
	return isSpawn
end
